tldr: Consistency and the note's stronger jointly measurable process-level conditional exchangeability identify the accelerated-initiation causal mean; fixed-time exchangeability alone is insufficient. The canonical independent-uniform extension leaves the seven-condition binary observed-law class unchanged. On that structured class, the exact minimax-capped observable rank estimator attains global minimax MSE \(\min\{\theta/n,n^{-2\beta/(2\beta+\kappa+1)}\}\), and the bias-aware connected interval attains matching uniformly honest expected length. The original capped pivot has a pointwise centered Gaussian limit under its explicit drift and cap-bias conditions, including every fixed \(\theta_n/b_n\to\varrho\in(0,1]\). Every fixed \(\rho>1\) admits oscillatory centering failure for that exact cap. This is not a general inference obstruction: the separate observable procedure with \(q_n=\min\{\theta_n,c_nb_n\}\), \(c_n\to\infty\), and \(c_nb_n/n\to0\) restores pointwise centered studentized normality for every deterministic sequence with \(\liminf\theta_n/b_n>0\), at standard-error scale \(\sqrt{q_n/n}\). The minimax frontiers and uniform bias-aware coverage remain unchanged.
